title: Interpolate Curve Disappears On Finish
summary: Finishing interpolate curve with only one placed point committed an empty diff: preview was stripped in `committed` while factory wireframe had no new edges. Added `hasTwoCurvePoints` guard on finish transitions and commit, `runCommit` rejects empty `command.finish` diffs, `replBaseDisplayForHistory` keeps preview until geometry commits, and through-nurbs wireframe sampling matches the in-command Catmull-Rom preview density.
